{{Vanilla|Redstone Lamp}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''electric lamp''' is a light that turns on when powered. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Redstone Lamp|redstone lamp}} under a new name, and it works the same way, giving light level 15 while powered.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The pack adds a cheap recipe: eight [[glass]] around an [[Electric Wire|electric wire]] make 8 electric lamps, like an incandescent bulb.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/incandescent_lamp.json}}</ref> The vanilla recipe, four wire around [[Crystallized Estus|crystallized estus]] (the pack's glowstone), still works and makes one.

=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]] sells 64 electric lamps for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/2/redstone_lamp.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
The pack adds electric lamps to the pickaxe's mineable list, so pickaxes break them quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>
